summary: Iteration 164 — backend-only testing of the new P1 Advanced Analytics Aggregation endpoint GET /api/admin/analytics/advanced. Built pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_advanced_analytics_164.py covering 19 tests: auth guards, days validation, response shape, seeded-data correctness, cache behavior, and empty-window handling. All 19/19 tests PASSED against the live preview URL with seeded demo data.
critical_code_review_comments: admin_ops.py line ~807 _aggregate_top_categories filters listings by created_at >= cutoff when counting sold_count — a listing created >30d ago but sold within the window will be excluded. This is internally consistent with sell_through_rate (sold/total within created_at window) but may under-count revenue for older listings sold recently. Consider documenting this choice or using sold_at/updated_at for sold_count attribution if business logic demands it.

admin_ops.py line ~712 _cache_get uses a module-level dict _ADVANCED_ANALYTICS_CACHE — fine for single-worker but not shared across uvicorn/gunicorn workers. Acceptable for now (documented in code comment: 'in-process per-Python-process'), but would not coalesce load with multi-worker deployments. Consider Redis if/when scaled.

Cache key is only 'advanced:{days}' — no invalidation on new transactions/listings. 60s TTL is acceptable since analytics tolerate 1-min staleness, but admins who just seeded data and immediately reload will see stale numbers for up to 60s. Could add a manual cache-bust endpoint or invalidate on tx paid events if needed.

_aggregate_top_sellers buy_now branch uses tx.get('transaction_date') while standard auction uses tx.get('created_at') — asymmetric date fields. Ensure buy_now_transactions consistently populate transaction_date; if null, the tx is silently excluded from the window. Low risk today (no buy_now data seeded) but a data-quality foot-gun.
